 Key Highlights

  • Can empower your computer to transfer 50% more data than DDR4 at launch, resulting in faster load times, file transfers, downloads, refresh rates and less lag time
  • DDR5 is not just faster than the previous generation due to higher bus efficiency — it's fundamentally better
  • Powers through heavy workloads and benefits from versatile downclocking for higher frame rates in gaming
  • On-module operating voltage of only 1.1V compared to DDR4's 1.2V for better energy efficiency
  • Simple plug-and-play at JEDEC default — XMP/EXPO profiles available for enthusiasts
